description: Regression cases for cynefin-compass. gate_cases are for model evals: run the prompt and check that the skill triggers (or skips) as expected. classification_cases are checked by scripts/tests/test_cynefin_compass.py against classify_from_answers().

gate_cases.prompt: Leadership wants a full plan to fix our falling activation rate by Friday. Nobody knows why users leave.
Half the team wants more analysis before we pick a pricing model. The other half wants to try prices on real customers. How should we decide?
The database is down, customers cannot log in, and we do not know why. We are about to start a post-mortem meeting.
Our deployment runbook has worked for two years. Last week three deploys failed in new ways. What now?
We are merging two teams with different cultures. Write a 12-month integration plan.
Should we adopt a new security tool? We need an expert comparison and a market reaction we cannot predict.
Help me decide how to approach modernising a legacy system that nobody fully understands, with shifting requirements.
Use Cynefin to assess whether we should plan or experiment with our new onboarding programme.
Our incident process is considered solved, so nobody reviews it. Is that safe?
A client keeps changing requirements and our estimate process is failing. What approach fits?
Rename the function parse_cfg to parse_config and update the callers.
Convert this CSV file to JSON.
What does the word Cynefin mean?
Fix the failing unit test in test_parser.py. The error says expected 3 got 2.
Write a SQL query that counts orders per customer last month.
Renew the TLS certificate using the runbook. Tell me the commands.
Summarise this meeting transcript in five bullet points.
Add a docstring to every public function in utils.py.
Format this document with the company template.
Bump the version number to 2.4.1 in package.json and the changelog.

classification_cases.scenario: Payments API fails for everyone and the cause is unknown.
Annual certificate renewal with a current runbook.
Find why the nightly batch job is slow. Profiling data exists.
Why users leave the onboarding flow.
Mixed bundle of unrelated issues with no clear shape.
Crisis during a routine task. Crisis wins over a known practice.
A known practice applies and an expert could also analyse it. Clear wins.
Experts can analyse the part and the rest only shows in hindsight. Complicated wins by order. Decompose if both parts matter.
